name: Grok Bot TUI
author: pixbroker
description: Unofficial Omarchy bar widget for the native Rust Grok Bot TUI. Reads a pushed inbox snapshot. Click a row to open that bot in the Rust TUI. Does not launch the Electron app.

barWidget.description: Inbox of latest bot messages. Click a row to open that bot in the Rust TUI.

schema.label: Rust TUI command
schema.description: Must be grokbot-tui or an absolute path ending in /grokbot-tui. Never Electron /usr/bin/grokbot. Do not put tokens here.

schema.label: Terminal app id
schema.description: Omarchy TUI window id used when opening a bot from the panel.

schema.label: What sits beside the logo
schema.description: The Grok Bot mark is always shown. To its right: avatars = the bots waiting on you, as themselves; count = how many are waiting; none = the mark alone.

schema.label: Panel order
schema.description: attention = bots waiting on you first, longest wait at the top, then a rule and everyone else by recency; channels = the sections from the snapshot; flat = purely by last message.

schema.label: Group the panel by channel
schema.description: Use the channels (sidebar sections) from the inbox snapshot when ordering is channels.

schema.label: Most avatars to show in the bar
